\begin{abstract}
We consolidate the exact partition-ratio programme after the Haar-entropy,
coherent-optimizer, and overlap-correct charging stages.  The coherent
continuous channel now has a strict conditional budget, while the incoherent
channel has a quantified charge--entropy deficit.  Center, cut/orbit, and
topology channels remain separated so that restricted results are not promoted
to the complete $SU(2)$ measure.
\end{abstract}

\section{The exact target}

For retained boundary state $s$, channel $c$, positive weight $V$, good
reference partition $Z_{G,\mathrm{ref}}$, and charged bad numerator $B_{V,c}$,
the open physical target remains
\[
 \sup_{\Lambda,s,c}
 \frac{B_{V,c}(s)}{Z_{G,\mathrm{ref}}(s)V(s)}
 \le e^{-F_*},
 \qquad F_*>6.71292101139.
\]
The supremum includes all finite volumes, positive-mass retained states,
adaptive histories, and defect channels.  The full normalizer cannot be
replaced by a pointwise action minimum.

\begin{theorem}[Conservative frontier statement]
The package proves two pieces of restricted or conditional progress: the exact
center-sector contour and the coherent-collar conditional budget.  It proves
zero complete physical channel estimates uniform in boundary state and volume.
Consequently the exact physical partition ratio, one-scale basin entry,
continuum construction, and mass gap remain open.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Each row of the executable ledger carries Boolean fields for normalized
partition control, boundary-state uniformity, volume uniformity, and physical
closure.  The center row lacks transfer to the continuous measure; the
coherent row retains a hypothesis; the incoherent row fails the common-parameter
test; the cut/orbit row lacks a numerator estimate; and the topology row lacks
a retained representation.  Hence no row meets all physical quantifiers.
\end{proof}

\section{The repair frontier}

Let $\eta_{\rm coh}$ be the largest coherence radius accepted at the maximum
nonlinear scale.  For charge amplification $A$ and effective connected degree
$D_{\rm eff}$, the rooted size-$k_0=2$ free energy is
\[
 2A\frac{\eta_{\rm coh}^2}{4t}-2\alpha-2\log D_{\rm eff}
 +\log\!\left(1-e^\alpha D_{\rm eff}^2
 e^{-A\eta_{\rm coh}^2/(4t)}\right).
\]
The accompanying calibration solves its level set at
$F_*=6.71292101139$.  At unit amplification the effective degree must fall to
the reported value near $2.2054$, far below the present coarse count $18$.
At degree $18$, amplification must reach about $1.55295$.  Intermediate
certified combinations form the preferred next target.

\section{Next mathematical target}

Construct a gauge-covariant canonical witness polymer that:
\begin{enumerate}
\item assigns each incoherent collar to retained, sector-aware witnesses;
\item proves exact overlap and connected-counting constants landing on the
      repair frontier;
\item compares its weighted numerator to the same retained-state good
      partition, uniformly over adaptive histories and finite volumes;
\item handles chart transitions and carries an explicit topology label.
\end{enumerate}

\begin{remark}
Only after these channel estimates close can the programme claim one-scale
nonlinear basin entry.  RG iteration, cutoff removal, Osterwalder--Schrader
reconstruction, and a positive Hamiltonian gap are later independent nodes.
\end{remark}
